comparison.objective: Wait for a printer bed to cool, remove a used plate level and install a clean one; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual flat-plate transport, sequencing and placement while retaining a loose print versus precision hex/collar manipulation and impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Plates must not move early or drop; print remains on the used plate and clean plate finishes flat on the bed. Candidate instead requires bounded repeated stops.
comparison.reason: Safe sequencing is shared, but plate exchange and damper commissioning test different physical abilities.
